 The Story of Heather Lindstrom • Story Arc 2 Chapters • 6 Bonus Scenes • ~52 minutes

Scales, Tails, and Safe People: Heather, Wesley & The Road to North Lion

2003–2028 • Wesley's Chesapeake Blowout, Ten Years Behind the Lens & Two Shared Families

Experience Heather Lindstrom's story alongside her non-verbal cousin Wesley—from the Saturday morning Wesley blew up over losing his first guy buddy Nate through building North Lion Scales & Tails in Maplewood and standing together in the restored White House Rose Garden.

Five Red X's on the Wall Calendar: Wesley's Perspective on the Morning He Thought He Lost Nate Forever

From Fifteen-Year-Old Non-Verbal Wesley Collins's Third-Person Limited Point of View — Why Heather's Breakup Felt Like Losing His Only Guy Friend on Earth

While Katie & Nathaniel follows Nate in Virginia Beach and The Story of Heather Lindstrom follows Heather in Chesapeake, this companion scene enters fifteen-year-old non-verbal Wesley Collins's own third-person limited perspective on Saturday morning, January 11, 2003—revealing the sheer terror of having zero phone, bus, or spoken bridge to his very first guy friend when Heather messed up.

Workstation Three, Cousin Hannah's Green Parka, & Why Heather Knew There Was No Restore Point

Inside Senior Homeroom 212 on January 6, Five Weeks of Empty Floor in Room 204, & The Cafeteria Lie That Left Heather Sick With Herself

 Behind-the-Scenes Bonus Scene 2016-02-07 ~6 min

Thirteen Hundred Miles Away in Maplewood: Missing Postcards, Seeing Katie on TV, & A Very Cautious Request

Why Twenty-Eight-Year-Old Wesley Was Overjoyed Watching Meet the Nation, How Heather Explained State Government Without Big Words, & Ten Quiet Weeks Waiting in Filtered Requests

What happened inside Heather and Dan Lindstrom's snowy Maplewood, Minnesota home in February and March 2016—from twenty-eight-year-old Wesley missing his Virginia bus postcards and cheering at Katie and Nate on Sunday morning television to trying to figure out what state government is and convincing Heather to send one very cautious message across thirteen years.

 Behind-the-Scenes Bonus Scene 2018-06-16 ~3 min

Architectural Blueprint & Visitor Guide: Inside North Lion Scales & Tails (Maplewood, MN)

Zero-Step Automatic Sliding Doors, The Front Supply Store & Customer Service Counter, Dr. Meyer's Vet Clinic, & Three Barrier-Free Zoo Wings for Turtles, Reptiles, and Small Mammals

A complete room-by-room architectural guide to Heather and Dan Lindstrom's barrier-free Maplewood facility—explaining how the front retail store, customer service counter, exotic vet clinic, skylit greenhouse conservatory, reptile galleries, and small mammal meadow fit together under one zero-step roof.

 Behind-the-Scenes Bonus Scene 2018-06-16 ~6 min

While the Classroom Door Was Closed: Staff Member Wesley, Cousin Chelsea, & Matching Blue Gloves at the Turtle Lagoon

The Full Twenty-Minute Conservatory Scene Between Wesley, Chelsea, Jonas, Nora, Molly, Brittany, and Dan During Nate, Katie, and Heather's Private Reckoning

Because Katie & Nathaniel is told strictly in Nathaniel's first-person perspective, the main novel follows Nate, Katie, and Heather behind the closed door of the Education Classroom. This Backstage scene stays out in the sunlit conservatory to show the joyful twenty minutes Staff Member Wesley and Cousin Chelsea spend feeding Clover, Scooter, and Barnaby in matching blue gloves.

8
 Behind-the-Scenes Bonus Scene 2028-09-15 ~5 min

Alternate 'What If' Dossier: Two Ground-Floor In-Law Suites — Virginia Beach & Maplewood

What If Chelsea and Wesley Were Allowed to Live Together Year-Round Across Matching Guardian-Connected Suites at 737 Arvin Road and Heather & Dan's Minnesota Home?

In main canon, Chelsea keeps her home base with Katie, Nate, and Brittany in Virginia while Wesley keeps his job at North Lion Scales & Tails in Minnesota, enjoying long cross-state visits after Senator Katie Prairie's 2028 reform law. This Alternate 'What If' explores the world where both guardian families build matching connected ground-floor in-law suites in BOTH Virginia Beach and Maplewood so Wesley and Chelsea can live together full-time!
